title: Delta Tokenizer: Reference-Identical Tokenization of Session Deltas and Segment-Parallelism for Long Prompts on Multicore CPUs
abstract: arXiv:2610.19801v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An agent that drives an LLM sends the model the same conversation again and again, and each turn adds only a little text at the end. Inference engines reuse the KV cache of the shared prefix, so only the new tokens pass through the model. However, tokenization has no such shortcut. The CPU front end of the serving engine converts every request back into token IDs from its first character, which lengthens the time to first token (TTFT) and consumes CPU on every turn.   We present Delta Tokenizer, a CPU tokenization front end that tokenizes only the delta between a request and the previous request of the same session. It retains the earlier token sequence, encodes again only the appended text and the short tail whose tokens the append could affect, and joins the two only at a position the tokenizer's splitting rules themselves cannot move, which keeps the result exact. translated_title: Delta Tokenizer：面向多核CPU的会话增量参考一致性分词与长提示词分段并行方法
translated_abstract: 驱动大语言模型的智能体会一次又一次地向模型发送相同的对话，每一轮只在末尾追加少量文本。推理引擎会复用共享前缀的KV缓存，因此只有新增的token会通过模型。然而，分词环节却没有这样的捷径。服务引擎的CPU前端会将每个请求从第一个字符开始重新转换为token ID，这延长了首token生成时间（TTFT），并且每一轮都消耗CPU资源。我们提出了Delta Tokenizer，一个CPU分词前端，它只对同一会话中当前请求与前一个请求之间的增量进行分词。它保留较早的token序列，仅重新编码追加的文本以及追加操作可能影响其token的短尾部，并且只在一个分词器切分规则本身无法移动的位置将两部分拼接，从而保证结果与完整分词完全一致。对于没有可复用状态的较长请求，它会对文本进行切分（原文在此处截断），以实现多核CPU上的分段并行处理。
tldr: 提出Delta Tokenizer，一种仅对会话增量进行分词且保证与完整分词结果完全一致的CPU分词前端，并利用分段并行加速多核CPU上长提示词的分词，显著降低TTFT和CPU开销。
en_tdlr: Delta Tokenizer is a CPU tokenization front end that tokenizes only the delta between consecutive requests in a session with reference-identical results, and employs segment-parallelism to accelerate long-prompt tokenization on multicore CPUs, reducing TTFT and CPU overhead.
